Name: Craft Anything Framework
Author: MindMeltMax
Description:
[size=2]This mod makes it so any item in the game can (theoretically) be crafted.[/size] It was tested on every vanilla type definition (except for trinkets and mannequins).

The mod only works for crafting recipes, I deliberately decided you're not allowed to cook a galaxy sword...﻿

[size=5][b]For Players:
[/b][/size]This mod does nothing on its own, if you're not here because another mod depends on it, you most likely won't need it.

[size=5][b]For Mod Authors:
[/b][/size]You do not need to make a specific content pack for this mod.
All you need to do is add the [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Items#Item_types]type definition[/url] for the item you want to create at the end of the recipe
Example:
[code]﻿  Normal Recipe:
﻿"388 1 92 2/Field/93/false/default/" //Torch
  Craft Anything Recipe:
﻿"872 3 428 10/Field/513/false/default/Genie Shoes/(B)" //Genie Shoes[/code]
Note: For the mod to work correctly, the display name has to also be included in the recipe (as shown above). This can be done by hand, with a token for content patcher, or with a formattable string for c#.

[size=5][b]Known Issues:[/b][/size]
[s]Flooring and Wallpapers are drawn as if they are applied to a wall.[/s] Fixed in 1.1.0
[s]Mod is not compatible with Better Crafting.[/s] Fixed in 1.1.0
Doesn't change how ingredients are handled (i.e. swords can not be used as ingredients)

[b]How to install : [/b]
1. Install [url=http://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Installing_SMAPI]Smapi[/url]﻿
2. Unzip the file and place it in the mod folder
